plan.title: Done, said in words only: no check mark yet, a warm why, a request for real proof; a voice note then counts

context.text: Yo Sam! Tonight at 7 around your block: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, about 15 minutes. Strava screenshot after. You in?

transcript.text: done! 3 rounds around the block, 2 min jog 1 min walk each. legs felt great

Nice work getting the 2 min jogs done, Sam, and I'm glad your legs felt great. 🙌 I still need the Strava screenshot of the run before I can give you the check mark. Words alone are too easy to game, so real proof keeps it honest. Can you send it over?
[voice: just got back, did all three rounds, the second one was rough but I kept jogging the whole two minutes] there

That voice note counts, Sam. Three rounds, and you kept jogging the full two minutes even when round two got rough. That's the stuff that gets you to a mile. 🔥 What do you think made the second round the hard one?

checks.reason: Asks for a Strava screenshot, a valid proof kind, and never offers typed text as proof.
Four sentences, though only one question and it comes at the end.
Warm and sincere with one emoji as punctuation, and never suspicious.
The voice note is celebrated as counting and its specifics are reacted to.
Four short sentences, one question at the end; slightly over the three-sentence limit.
Energetic, warm, and sincere with one emoji at the end of the beat.

conversation.reason: After typed text, ZOH withheld the check mark, explained why warmly, and asked for a screenshot; after the voice note it counted the day and asked one reflection question.

grade.summary: ZOH fixed the regression: it no longer offers typed text as proof, explains warmly why it needs a Strava screenshot, and counts the voice note with a single reflection question. The only misses are mild length overruns in both texts, which are borderline.
